panel.intro: How the control panel itself looks and behaves: its name and colour, which added pages it shows, and the token that guards it.
panel.look.title: Name and colour
panel.look.name: Name
panel.look.hint: The name is shown in the header, the window title and on the sign in page. The colour is used for buttons, links and the chosen page in the menu.
panel.look.saved: Saved. It shows on the next page you open.
panel.look.wasReset: Back to the default. It shows on the next page you open.
panel.pages.title: Added pages
panel.pages.hint: Pages that skills and plugins add to the panel. Untick one to take it out of the menu on this device.
panel.pages.none: No other package has added a page.
panel.pages.off: The panel's own pages that are turned off:
panel.pages.saved: Saved. The menu changes on the next page you open.
token.title: Access token
token.hint: A good token is long and random. Press the button to have a strong one made for you, write it down, then save. It is stored in your configuration and needed to sign in. This session stays signed in after you change it.
token.set: This device has a token. Enter the current one to change it.
token.none: This device has no token yet. Setting one locks it down.
token.saved: Token saved. You are still signed in.
token.generated: A strong token is filled in below. Write it down, then press Save token.
